prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with rubies in brass-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 26% of the way down her figure from the top and about 56% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
